# RECEIPT t5: missing data and weights sweep

**Lane:** sweep-oct16 / t5 · **Date:** 2026-10-16 · **Run in:** cloud session only (not the shared box)
**Pins:** drmTMB `ca3ddefa5ea11bbfd3b765615dfbb89305d2485a` · DRModels.jl `f71b2923360e9e5d4591e0d6e15a9ef9db0356d7`
**Environment:** R 4.3.3, TMB 1.9.10, JuliaCall 0.17.6, Julia 1.12.7 (conda-forge), DRModels 0.7.2, Ubuntu 24.04, 4 cores. Details are in [`results/env/`](results/env/).
**Reader:** Engine A and the maintainers deciding what to fix. Every number below is regenerated by `R/compare.R` from the committed result files, except where a probe script is named.

## Verdict

| Pass bar (lane brief) | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Integer weights equal row duplication to 1e-8 in logLik and coefficients | **PASS (native)**. Not testable on Julia: weights are fenced or unimplemented. | Native: max \|ΔlogLik\| 1.7e-10, max \|Δcoef\| 1.5e-10, 27/27 cells. Julia on duplicated rows matches native weighted fits to 1.6e-10 in logLik. |
| NA rows dropped identically in R and Julia (nobs equal) | **PASS through the bridge (Gaussian) and through `drm_listwise`. FAIL for raw `drm()`. BLOCKED for the Poisson/Gamma bridge.** | Bridge Gaussian 9/9 and `drm_listwise` 27/27 equal native nobs, and the `drm_listwise` fits equal the complete-case fits exactly. Raw `drm()` throws `KeyError` in 18/18 cells with NA in x (DRModels.jl#1089), and NaN-coded x misbehaves (DRModels.jl#1113). Out-of-grid: a missing `g` is pooled rather than dropped (DRModels.jl#1112). The Poisson/Gamma bridge aborts before returning (drmTMB#1551). |
| `engine = "julia"` matches native | **PASS for Gaussian `(1\|g)`. FAIL/BLOCKED for Poisson/Gamma `(1\|g)`.** | Gaussian: max \|ΔlogLik\| 2.0e-12, max \|Δcoef\| 1.8e-10, 9/9. Poisson and Gamma abort in 18/18 cells after the Julia fit (drmTMB#1551). DRModels.jl itself matches native at 9.7e-11 with `marginal = :Laplace`, which the bridge never sends. An explicit `miss_control()` with NA in x is honoured natively but bypassed under Julia (6/6; drmTMB#1454 comment). |

**Issues filed:**
- [drmTMB#1550](https://github.com/itchyshin/drmTMB/issues/1550): `%||%` undefined on R < 4.4. It blocks every `engine = "julia"` call, and fixes already exist in open drafts #1502 and #1504.
- [drmTMB#1551](https://github.com/itchyshin/drmTMB/issues/1551): Poisson/Gamma `(1|g)` bridge crash at the `resd` label, with `marginal` never sent.
- [DRModels.jl#1111](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/1111) (high): a `Vector{Union{Missing,Float64}}` predictor that holds **no** missing value is dummy-coded as a factor, and `drm_listwise` passes it through unchanged. The fit is silent and saturated, or, with few distinct values, plausible and reported as converged.
- [DRModels.jl#1112](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/1112) (medium): a `missing` in the `(1 | g)` grouping column is silently pooled into an extra random-effect level. nobs is unchanged and the fit reports `converged = true`, whereas drmTMB drops those rows.
- [DRModels.jl#1113](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/1113) (low): a NaN or Inf predictor with `(1 | g)`. Poisson, NB2, Binomial and Student return a fit made of starting values; Gaussian and Gamma throw unnamed errors. This is already fixed on draft DRModels.jl#1045.

**Comments on existing issues:**
- [drmTMB#1454](https://github.com/itchyshin/drmTMB/issues/1454#issuecomment-6223761007): explicit `miss_control()` is bypassed under `engine = "julia"`.
- [drmTMB#1450](https://github.com/itchyshin/drmTMB/issues/1450#issuecomment-6223764153): `weights = NULL` is refused under `engine = "julia"`.
- [DRModels.jl#1089](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/1089#issuecomment-6224084518): `KeyError` on missing x, with per-family y-NA behaviour.
- [DRModels.jl#931](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/931#issuecomment-6224087748): there is no `weights =` keyword; reference values for the duplication identity.
- [DRModels.jl#947](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/947#issuecomment-6225126742): on the ordinary-Laplace route, tightening `g_tol` is inert or harmful. A polish that meets `g_tol` is discarded at `ordinary_laplace.jl:165` on a ~1e-13 objective difference.
- [DRModels.jl#1089 follow-up](https://github.com/itchyshin/DRModels.jl/issues/1089#issuecomment-6225128898): links #1111, #1112 and #1113 and states their fix-scope interaction with #1089.

Known items named in the brief:
- **DRModels#1089** is reproduced, and extended to Poisson and Gamma.
- **#1459 / #1513** concern `mi()` weights. They are drmTMB items: #1459 is an issue, and #1513 is a *draft PR*, not an issue. This lane's grid has no `mi()` cells, so neither was exercised. Weights on non-`mi()` routes are clean natively (see below).

## Grid and data

- **Families:**
  - `gaussian()` with `bf(y ~ x + (1 | g), sigma ~ 1)`
  - `poisson(link = "log")` with `bf(y ~ x + (1 | g))`
  - `Gamma(link = "log")` with `bf(y ~ x + (1 | g), sigma ~ 1)`
- **Design:** 25 groups × 8 rows (n = 200). `x, u ~ N(0, 1)`.
  - Gaussian: `y = 1 + 0.5x + 0.7u + ε`, σ = 1.
  - Poisson: `log μ = 0.5 + 0.4x + 0.5u`.
  - Gamma: `log μ = 1 + 0.3x + 0.5u`, CV 0.5.
- **Missingness:** MCAR, with an exact count per mask. The masks on y and x are independent, with fractions {0, 5, 20}% each. All 3×3 combinations are run, for 27 datasets.
- **Weights columns:** `w_int` ~ U{1, 2, 3} and `w_pos = exp(N(0, 0.75²))`.
- **Seeds:** nominal `20261016500 + k`, k = 0…26, in the order family → NA(y) → NA(x). These exceed R's 32-bit `set.seed()` range, so the effective R seed is `nominal %% .Machine$integer.max` (933663677 … 933663703). Both values are in [`data/manifest.csv`](data/manifest.csv).
- **File format:** doubles are written with `%.17g`, so R and Julia parse bit-identical values.

## Legs and checks

| Leg | Script | What it fits per dataset |
|---|---|---|
| Native | [`R/run_native.R`](R/run_native.R) | weights omitted / `NULL` / all-ones / `w_int` / `w_int` row-duplicated / `w_pos` / `w_pos` on pre-dropped rows / explicit `miss_control()`. Also checks the objective at fixed θ̂ (weighted vs duplicated, omitted vs ones, NA vs pre-dropped). |
| Bridge (`engine = "julia"`) | [`R/run_bridge.R`](R/run_bridge.R) | the same weight variants, explicit `miss_control()`, and the duplicated data with weights omitted |
| Direct DRModels.jl | [`julia/run_direct.jl`](julia/run_direct.jl) | raw columns with `missing` (CSV.jl-style typing), NaN-coded missing, `drm_listwise`, complete cases (default `:LA` and `marginal = :Laplace`), duplicated rows, and `weights =` |
| Oracle | [`R/oracle.R`](R/oracle.R) | an independent per-group Laplace marginal in which weights multiply the row log-density and the RE prior is unweighted. It is exact for Gaussian. It was written from the likelihood definition, not from drmTMB code. |
| Comparison | [`R/compare.R`](R/compare.R) | regenerates [`results/summary.md`](results/summary.md) and [`results/cells.csv`](results/cells.csv) |
| Probes | [`julia/probe_union.jl`](julia/probe_union.jl), [`R/run_probe_g.R`](R/run_probe_g.R), [`R/run_probe_wt.R`](R/run_probe_wt.R), [`R/run_probe_include.R`](R/run_probe_include.R), [`julia/check_gtol.jl`](julia/check_gtol.jl) | Union-eltype and missing-group hazards; weights × missingness; Gaussian `response = "include"` across engines; the `g_tol` check |
| Verification | [`results/verification/`](results/verification/) | Each DRModels.jl candidate was checked by two independent agents (reproduce-and-trace; skeptic/triage) plus a completeness critic, and only the reconciled findings were filed. drmTMB#1551 and the #1454 comment rest on a fresh-session repro and a source trace. |

The tolerance is the brief's **1e-8** absolute, applied to logLik and to every coefficient: β_μ, β_σ, and log SD(g). The same 1e-8 is used for engine parity; the repo's own tests use 1e-6 / 1e-5 there.

## Deviations, caveats, and what this does not show

- **R < 4.4 shim.** The pinned drmTMB calls base `%||%` without defining it (drmTMB#1550). The bridge-leg scripts define base R 4.4's `%||%` in `globalenv()`, and no package code is modified. The native leg does not use the shim and does not need it.
- **Toolchain provenance.** CRAN, julialang.org and Docker Hub were blocked or rate-limited from this container. R dependencies came from Ubuntu apt, JuliaCall from the `cran/JuliaCall` GitHub mirror, Julia 1.12.7 from conda-forge, and Julia packages from the General registry cloned over git. Exact versions are in `results/env/`. Prior receipts used Julia 1.10.x and 1.12.6/7.
- **Integrators.** Native drmTMB fits Poisson/Gamma `(1 | g)` by Laplace. DRModels.jl defaults to `marginal = :LA`, a 5-node adaptive Gauss–Hermite rule, so "Julia matches native" is only meaningful with `marginal = :Laplace`. That is what the direct leg compares. The default-integrator gap (≤ 4.5e-2 logLik) is reported as informative, not as a failure.
- **Coefficient precision of DRModels' Laplace route.** Julia on duplicated rows vs native integer weights gives max \|Δcoef\| 2.0e-8 in 2/18 Poisson/Gamma cells, while \|ΔlogLik\| is ≤ 1.6e-10. Native's own weighted-vs-duplicated fits agree to 1.5e-10, so the duplication identity holds. The residual is where DRModels' optimiser stops: the exact TMB gradient at Julia's θ̂ is 8.9e-6 and 5.0e-6, and one Newton step (2.0e-8 / 1.3e-8) closes the gap. Two independent verifiers traced the cause: `src/ordinary_laplace.jl:165` throws away an LBFGS polish that met `g_tol`, because of a ~1e-13 objective difference, so the gradient-accepted Newton polish never runs. This is inside the route's documented 1e-5 parity contract. It is recorded on DRModels.jl#947 and not filed separately.
- **Engine parity with weights is untestable at these pins.** Every weights argument, including `NULL`, is refused by `engine = "julia"` (drmTMB#1450, draft fix #1502), and DRModels.jl has no `weights =` keyword (DRModels.jl#931, #691; draft #1061). The cross-engine weight check is therefore done through row duplication.
- **No `mi()` cells and no REML.** The grid is ML only, mean-side `(1 | g)` only, with `sigma ~ 1`.
- **Union-eltype probe runtime.** The pathological factor-coded fits take 20 s to more than 7 min each. They run one per process under `timeout 300` ([`julia/run_probes.sh`](julia/run_probes.sh)), outside the main grid. The first direct run, which included them in the grid, was stopped and replaced; it was not used.

## Reproduce

```sh
# from the drmTMB repository root, with drmTMB installed from the pin and a DRModels.jl checkout at the pin
export DRMODELS_JL_PATH=/path/to/DRModels.jl JULIA_HOME=/path/to/julia/bin
cd sweep-oct16/t5
Rscript R/gen_data.R data                                   # 27 CSVs + manifest.csv (deterministic)
Rscript R/run_native.R data results/native.csv              # ~25 s
Rscript R/run_bridge.R data results/bridge.csv              # ~4 min including Julia start-up
julia --project=$DRMODELS_JL_PATH julia/run_direct.jl data results/julia_direct.csv
julia/run_probes.sh data results/julia_probes.csv 300       # supplementary DRModels probes
Rscript R/run_probe_g.R data results/r_probe_g.csv          # R side of the missing-g probe
Rscript R/run_probe_wt.R data results/r_probe_wt.csv        # weights x missingness probes
Rscript R/run_probe_include.R data results/r_probe_include.csv  # response = "include" across engines
julia --project=$DRMODELS_JL_PATH julia/check_gtol.jl data gamma_y20_x20 poisson_y05_x20
Rscript R/compare.R results                                 # summary.md, cells.csv
```

Minimal repros: drmTMB#1551 [`repro/repro_resd_label.R`](repro/repro_resd_label.R); DRModels.jl#1111 [`repro/repro_union_eltype.jl`](repro/repro_union_eltype.jl); #1112 [`repro/repro_missing_group.jl`](repro/repro_missing_group.jl); #1113 [`repro/repro_nan_predictor.jl`](repro/repro_nan_predictor.jl). Each `.jl` has its captured `.out` alongside, and they share [`repro/common.jl`](repro/common.jl).
